prerequisites: Basic knowledge of technical computer science (switching networks and circuits)

learning_outcomes.text: After completing the module, students will have knowledge and experience in how to design and test simple hardware components using description languages and map them to programmable hardware.
They understand the functioning of a simple processor and its programming in Assembler.
They have knowledge about the structure of simple computers from processor, memory and periphery.
They know the essential types of peripheral units.
Based on the fundamentals of technical computer science, students will be able to design digital processing units and understand the functionality of simple computers built upon them.
After completing the module, students are able to design simple synchronous, digital circuits for data processing and make them runnable on programmable hardware.

assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a written exam as per the valid study regulations. The ungraded assessment is experimental work, consisting of approximately 5 experiments.
